tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List top-level Amazon US product categories and their subcategories covered by this service (US market only).

tools.name: get_top100
tools.description:
Get the Amazon US Top-100 Best Sellers Rank list for a product category (US market only).
    Pass exactly one of: category_id (a top-level category slug from list_categories,
    e.g. "pet-supplies") or subcategory_id (a numeric subcategory node id from
    list_categories, e.g. "3742171"). Omittin

tools.name: get_category_brief
tools.description: Get a structured brief for a category: market overview, considering factors, gotchas, common questions, needs, and keywords.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description:
Get a product's full profile: specs, full description, feature bullets, ratings, price,
    trend, dimension scores/percentiles, three-source facts check, red-flag signals, and sentiment.
    profile.full_description carries the complete listing description paragraph when available
    in the source

tools.name: search_products
tools.description:
Search for candidate products matching a query, each with a data-maturity tier.
    query: 1-8 space-separated plain words (no SQL/special chars).
    category_id: optional top-level category slug from list_categories (e.g. "pet-supplies").
    sort (enum): price_asc | price_desc | rating_desc | rev

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description:
Compare two to five products side-by-side across dimensions.
    asins: a list of 2-5 valid ASINs (10-char alphanumeric, e.g. "B08N5WRWNW").
    Fewer than 2 or more than 5 items returns an error.

tools.name: request
tools.description:
Fetch structured data by URL or ASIN with optional field filters.
    Pass either url (an Amazon product page URL) or asin (10-char alphanumeric).
    fields (optional enum): profile | price | trend | ratings | competitiveness |
    seller | facts_check | red_flags | sentiment | data_limitations.

tools.name: get_price
tools.description: Get a product's latest price and product-page link.

tools.name: get_price_change
tools.description: Get a product's 180-day price change summary from recorded history: current price, 180-day low/high/average, sample count, and where the current price sits among its own recorded observations. tools.name: scrap_page
tools.description: Scrape a product page in real time via a live data endpoint (~15-30s) for the latest price, stock, Buy Box seller, rating, and review count. The response carries data_as_of (when the platform observed the data) and an is_stale flag for freshness judgment.
